description: This file defines the SwiftUI view 'GatewayOnboardingView' and its helper views, facilitating user onboarding for connecting to a gateway via auto-detection or manual entry. It includes logic for handling setup codes, manual input, and connection status updates.

classes.name: AutoDetectStep
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for auto-detecting and connecting to a gateway on the network.

classes.name: ManualEntryStep
classes.description: A SwiftUI view allowing manual entry of gateway connection parameters.

classes.name: ConnectionStatusBox
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that displays the current connection status and related information.

methods.name: gatewayConnectionStatusLines
methods.description: Generates status lines describing current connection and discovery state.

methods.name: resetGatewayConnectionState
methods.description: Resets the connection state and references to disconnect and clear status messages.

methods.name: gatewayConnectionStatusSection
methods.description: Builds a section UI component for displaying connection status.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Handles the manual connection process to a gateway with provided parameters.

methods.name: manualPortValue
methods.description: Parses the port number input into an integer.

methods.name: applySetupCode
methods.description: Processes and applies a setup code, configuring manual connection parameters accordingly.

methods.name: applyURL
methods.description: Parses a URL and sets manual connection fields based on its components.
